result.title: Beyond Family Labels: A Taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Prior for Avian 3D Shape Recovery
result.summary: Recovering 3D pose and shape of birds from single images is bottlenecked by the long tail of avian diversity: out of ~10,000 species, only a few dozen have 3D-labeled training data, and in-the-wild test sets routinely contain species never seen at training. Generalizing across clades is therefore a central problem. The current state of the art, AniMer+, mitigates it with a family-level contrastive loss that conveys only a binary same-family indicator per pair and discards the continuous structure of the species tree. We propose a taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck prior on the shape code of the AVES parametric bird mesh model: a multivariate Gaussian whose covariance decays exponentially with Linnaean rank distance, with a learnable selection strength and noise scale. The prior generalizes family contrastive into a continuous, generative form, exposing the graded cross- and within-family similarity that a binary indicator cannot, and brings continuous comparative phylogenetics in as a biology-grounded inductive bias for the long tail. Our method improves over AniMer+ on both metrics of the unseen-species CowBird benchmark and on CtrlAVES3D, while remaining comparable on seen-species CUB. A permutation ablation isolates taxonomic structure from generic Gaussian smoothing, and a rank-granularity ablation identifies cross-order distinctions (the structure beyond a family-vs-not indicator) as the dominant source of the unseen-species gain.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对单图像鸟类3D姿态与形状恢复在长尾物种上的泛化，在AVES参数化鸟网格的形状编码上引入分类学Ornstein-Uhlenbeck先验：以随林奈阶元距离指数衰减的协方差构造高斯先验，取代AniMer+的家族级二值对比损失，并在未见物种基准上取得提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 用层级距离构造连续协方差来约束latent 形状编码的做法，可能为LVR中latent状态的结构化先验与表示几何（如按推理深度或位置组织相似度）提供启发，但其任务与视觉推理相距较远，且该先验是否仅为训练期正则尚需核查。
